title: Word order: SVOMPT and questions
subtitle: English File · sentence order, questions and translation

blocks.title: SVOMPT
blocks.text: Subject + Verb + Object + Manner + Place + Time. Наречия частоты usually / always обычно стоят перед основным глаголом.

blocks.title: 1. Put the words in the correct order

items.prompt: We / had / a lovely time / at a campsite / last weekend
items.answer: We had a lovely time at a campsite last weekend

items.prompt: My friends / usually / book flights online / in the evenings
items.answer: My friends usually book flights online in the evenings
items.explanation: Frequency adverb before the main verb

items.prompt: He / went skiing / in a very crowded place / yesterday
items.answer: He went skiing in a very crowded place yesterday

blocks.title: 2. Put the questions in the correct order

items.prompt: Did / you / hire / a bicycle / on the beach / yesterday?
items.answer: Did you hire a bicycle on the beach yesterday?

items.prompt: Why / was / this hotel / so noisy / last summer?
items.answer: Why was this hotel so noisy last summer?

items.prompt: Where / do / they / usually / buy souvenirs / abroad?
items.answer: Where do they usually buy souvenirs abroad?

items.explanation: We stayed in a very basic hotel yesterday.
options: Yesterday we stayed in a very basic hotel.
We stayed in a very basic hotel yesterday.
We yesterday stayed in a hotel very basic.

items.prompt: How do you ask about a dirty beach in the past?
items.explanation: Why was the beach so dirty last week?
options: Why the beach was so dirty last week?
Why did the beach be so dirty last week?
Why was the beach so dirty last week?

items.prompt: Choose the correct Present Simple question.
items.explanation: Does he always sunbathe on the beach in the morning?
options: Does he always sunbathe on the beach in the morning?
Does he sunbathe always on the beach in the morning?
He always does sunbathe on the beach in the morning?

items.prompt: В прошлый вторник погода была ужасной и туманной.
items.answer: The weather was awful and foggy last Tuesday
acceptedAnswers: The weather was awful and foggy last Tuesday
The weather was terrible and foggy last Tuesday
items.explanation: The weather was awful / terrible and foggy last Tuesday.

items.prompt: Куда вы обычно ездите за границу летом?
items.answer: Where do you usually go abroad in summer
acceptedAnswers: Where do you usually go abroad in summer
Where do you usually go abroad in the summer
items.explanation: Where do you usually go abroad in summer?

items.prompt: Она не фотографировала многолюдный город вчера.
items.answer: She didn't take photos of the crowded city yesterday
acceptedAnswers: She didn't take photos of the crowded city yesterday
She did not take photos of the crowded city yesterday
items.explanation: She didn't take photos of the crowded city yesterday.
